function: ABC transporter modulating cadmium (Cd) import, thus controlling Cd(2+) accumulation to prevent phytotoxicity (PubMed:35640876). Confers high tolerance to Cd in yeast (PubMed:21670506). Prevents leaf bacteria proliferation, such as Xanthomonas oryzae pv. oryzicola (Xoc) RS105 and X.oryzae pv. oryzae (Xoo) PXO99, by triggering Cd accumulation, which in turn impairs bacterial virulence factors (PubMed:35640876).
